checklist_100.note: The in-game 100% checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion) only appears after the story, but earlier progress counts. You do not need everything — only the numbers below. Source: KeenGamer 100% tables; Output Lag.

tasks.label: Meditations (15 of 18 for 100%; all 18 for the trophy)

phases.intro: Play the story with Jason and Lucia, and guard the one thing that can be missed. Everything else stays available after the credits.
steps: Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing (Just Like Paradise).
After the mission Down to Earth, look for Lucia at Jason’s house in the morning. Follow her to the balcony and accept the meditation — this is the one missable moment in the game.
Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter; keep the Chapter 1 save until Positive Mental Attitude pops.
Complete Chapters 1–4 and the story missions: Breakfast Run, The Cartel Heist, Child’s Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown, Operation Savage Glory.
In Chapter 2, rob Kingpin Bowling with Sticky Bombs (Let’s Go Bowling).
In Chapter 3, do Race Against Yago the moment it appears (time-sensitive), and get the Snap Gun from Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs for Sneakthief.
Near the end of Chapter 4, do That’s Where The Money Is to unlock the bank vaults.
Keep one untouched manual save from just before the final mission, then finish it.
phases.title: Phase 1 — Story & the one missable
trophies: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

phases.intro: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work the 35-item checklist. Earlier progress counts, so much of it is already done.
steps: Do the robberies first: 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults, and the fencing totals.
Then the collectibles: 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 flamingos, 15 of 18 meditations.
Then the activities: 42 shooting range golds, 42 drone time trials, 300 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges, 15 Bret target decks.
Scan vehicles and study animals from the start — you need 200 of 277 vehicles and 100 of 255 animals, and doing it naturally saves hours of cleanup.
Do not chase everything: the checklist only needs selected portions of most activities, and many collectibles can be skipped entirely.
phases.title: Phase 2 — 100% completion

phases.intro: With the story done and 100% reached, finish the character questlines and whatever is left. All six side finales stay open after the credits.
steps: Complete the final missions for Andy (Lucia-only), Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone (Jason-only) and Bret (Jason-only hunting).
Finish 8 qualifying Strangers & Freaks strands — Andy’s, Billy’s and Tyrone’s questlines do not count toward this total.
Meditate at any remaining spots for Positive Mental Attitude.
Pick up the remaining combat, driving, robbery and miscellaneous trophies.
Check the tracker: when all 54 others are earned, Vice Got a Price! pops.
phases.title: Phase 3 — Finales & cleanup

save_strategy.note: GTA 6 has no mission replay and no New Game Plus. Your saves are the only way back.
steps: Make a manual save at the start of every chapter.
Keep one untouched manual save from just before the final mission.
Keep the Chapter 1 save until Positive Mental Attitude pops.
The game has 15 manual save slots plus one autosave — rotate the rest.
Never use cheats on your trophy save: cheats should switch off trophies and saving.
Do Race Against Yago the moment it appears in Chapter 3 — it is time-sensitive.
